Rohan Verma
rohan.verma98@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx02 | linkedin.com/in/rohanverma | Mysuru
SUMMARY
Full stack developer with a strong portfolio of deployed React/Node projects and active hackathon participation.
Comfortable working across the stack from database design to UI polish.
EDUCATION
B.Tech Information Technology, Manipal Institute of Technology (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.9/10
SKILLS
React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, TypeScript, REST APIs, Docker (basic), Git, Postman,
Figma (basic)
EXPERIENCE
Freelance Web Developer (2025-Present)
•
Delivered 3 small business websites with React frontends and Node/Express backends
•
Set up PostgreSQL schemas and REST APIs for client inventory management systems
PROJECTS
EventHive - College Event Management Platform
•
Built with Next.js, Express, and PostgreSQL; supports event registration and QR-based check-in
•
Won 2nd place at a regional inter-college hackathon (2026)
Expense Tracker API
•
Designed REST APIs in Node.js/Express with JWT auth; documented with Swagger
CERTIFICATIONS
The Complete Node.js Developer Course (Udemy)
